facts.label: Talent data: Arcane
facts.value: Compared with Classic 1.12, the Arcane tree adds Missile Barrage, Arcane Geometry, Arcane Blast and Arcane Wrath, and Arcane Focus and Magic Attunement are gone. The tree holds 45 talent points.
facts.note: Blizzard's Mage deep dive says Magic Attunement's effect is now baseline.

facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: Improved Scorch and Winter's Chill now help only the Mage who applies them, and every Mage has their own Ignite. Blizzard cites threat and damage-attribution problems, so one Mage no longer keeps Scorch up for the whole raid.

facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: Frostfire Bolt is a level-40 trainer spell with a 3 sec cast. It counts as Fire and Frost, uses your higher Fire or Frost spell damage against the target's lower resistance, and adds a DoT and a slow.

facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: Down-ranking is penalised for every caster: spells cast far below your level get less from spell power and are less likely to trigger talents (Blizzard's example: a rank 1 Frostbolt at 60 has no Frostbite chance). Frost also lost farming power: Cone of Cold slows for less time and Improved Blizzard's slow is capped lower.

facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: Blizzard removed Arcane Focus, Frost Blast and Piercing Ice. Precision in the Frost tree now improves hit with all spells by 2%, 4% or 6%.

facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: Ice Block is now the 16-point Frost talent and Cold Snap the 21-point one, with a 10 min cooldown. Arcane Power now needs Presence of Mind, and Ice Barrier needs Cold Snap.
facts.gameBuild: WoW: Forever (launch 4 Nov 2026; talent data of 10 Nov 2026)

facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: Comprehension is a new Mage-only minor tradeskill. Comprehend Scroll, in the General tab of your spellbook, deciphers scrolls that creatures drop, and Blizzard leaves the rewards for players to find.

facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: Missile Barrage moved to row 2 and is consumed when Arcane Missiles starts. Ice Lance shares an 8-second cooldown with Fire Blast.

facts.label: Talent data: Fire
facts.value: Compared with Classic 1.12, the Fire tree adds one talent, Heating Up, and no Classic Fire talent is gone. The tree holds 46 talent points.

facts.label: Talent data: Frost
facts.value: Compared with Classic 1.12, the Frost tree adds Ice Lance and Fingers of Frost, and Piercing Ice is gone. The tree holds 48 talent points.

facts.label: Blizzard's class view
facts.value: Blizzard describes the Mage through unique buffs, conjured food and water, strong control such as Polymorph, and strong single-target and area damage. The weak spot is melee range.

facts.label: Frost for leveling and PvP
facts.value: Warcraft Tavern's beta Mage guide says Frost has mostly been used for leveling and PvP.

facts.label: Mage class quests (levels 10, 15 and 26)
facts.value: Warcraft Tavern's beta leveling guide lists Mage class quests at these levels, with rewards such as robes, staves, off-hands and wands. Quests above level 26 are not documented yet.

facts.label: Teleports from the portal trainer (levels 20 and 30)
facts.value: Alliance: Teleport: Stormwind and Teleport: Ironforge at 20, Teleport: Darnassus at 30. The files show the same spells as Classic, taught by portal trainers. Warcraft Tavern lists Rune of Teleportation as the reagent.

facts.label: Portals from the portal trainer (levels 40 and 50)
facts.value: Alliance: Portal: Stormwind and Portal: Ironforge at 40, Portal: Darnassus at 50. Warcraft Tavern lists Rune of Portals as the reagent.

facts.label: Teleport: Dalaran (50 in the files)
facts.value: A new spell flagged for Alliance races only and not sold by the class trainer. How you obtain it is unconfirmed, so treat it as a datamine hint (talentsforever).

facts.label: Comprehension: Comprehend Scroll (level 6 in beta reports)
facts.value: Blizzard confirms the Mage-only tradeskill and leaves rewards to discovery. Beta reports from Warcraft Tavern: a failed decipher turns you into a sheep until the skill improves, and returning books to librarians unlocks a Research tradeskill.

facts.label: Conjure Water and Conjure Food (Water from level 4)
facts.value: Unchanged in the files: 20 bottles of water per cast across 7 ranks. Conjure Food rank 6 now makes 20 sweet rolls (Classic: 18). Mana gems are unchanged.

facts.label: Spell hit cap against raid bosses (Forever)
facts.note: No Forever value is published. Icy Veins says a cap exists but the number is unknown, and Warcraft Tavern notes the beta UI did not show your spell hit chance.

facts.label: Classic 1.12 hit cap (reference only)
facts.value: 16% spell hit against bosses three levels higher; 1% of spells always miss

facts.label: Spell hit from talents
facts.value: Precision in the Frost tree grants 2%, 4% or 6% spell hit. Arcane Focus was removed.

facts.label: Stat focus
facts.value: Spell power and spell hit lead; the guides disagree on which comes first
facts.note: Warcraft Tavern (beta) ranks spell power first and hit second; Icy Veins treats hit as the top stat until capped.

facts.label: Arcane Blast stacks
facts.value: Each stack adds 12% of Intellect as Spell Damage and raises the spell's mana cost by 100%. The stack lasts 18 seconds.

facts.label: Arcane Wrath
facts.value: 3.5 sec cast, 6 sec cooldown, base damage similar to Fireball plus spell damage equal to 5% of maximum mana

facts.label: Raid utility
facts.value: Arcane Brilliance (party and raid Intellect), Dampen and Amplify Magic, and Remove Lesser Curse, which also removes Banes
facts.note: Icy Veins Forever; the files (talentsforever) also show Arcane Brilliance reaching the raid. A Gamewave report on the 16 Oct beta patch says Arcane Intellect is still cast per group, so check it in game. In the files Arcane Intellect lasts 1 hour (was 30 min).

facts.label: Threat control: Arcane Subtlety
facts.value: Arcane Subtlety: your Arcane spells cause 15% less threat at rank 1 and 30% less at rank 2.

facts.label: Mana on long fights: Arcane Meditation
facts.value: Arcane Meditation lets 17% of your mana regeneration continue while casting, 33% with two points and 50% at 3/3. It requires Arcane Concentration.

facts.label: Mage Armor regeneration (datamine)
facts.value: In the talentsforever datamine, Mage Armor lets 50% of your mana regeneration continue while casting (Classic: 30%).

facts.label: Alliance racials for raiders
facts.value: Human Ruthless +1% crit; Gnome Eureka! is an 8 sec buff that makes non-periodic abilities 10% cheaper and stronger; High Order Skyborne Wind-Blessed +2% haste. Skyborne's Attuned bonus is removed when you enter a raid.

facts.label: Launch raids
facts.value: From 9 Dec 2026: The Barrow Deeps (10 players), Hyjal Summit (20) and Onyxia's Lair (40, each raider carries a Drakefire Amulet)

facts.label: Onyxia
facts.value: Blizzard tells raids to build fire resistance before Onyxia's Lair and gives no target number

facts.label: Raid DPS rankings
facts.note: Icy Veins lists raid DPS rankings as TBD, and no Forever raid logs exist yet.

facts.label: PvP rankings
facts.note: Icy Veins' Forever PvP overview lists every Mage spec as TBD.

facts.label: Classic 1.12 caster kit (reference)
facts.value: Flask of Supreme Power, Greater Arcane Elixir, Brilliant Wizard Oil, Major Mana Potion, Mageblood Potion, Demonic or Dark Rune, Nightfin Soup, Runn Tum Tuber Surprise

facts.label: Forever alchemy
facts.value: Healing potions moved to First Aid, new elixirs include Minor Arcane Elixir, and flasks are brewed at a portable Alchemy Laboratory camp object

facts.label: World buffs in raids
facts.value: Rallying Cry of the Dragonslayer is marked 'No effect while in a raid instance' in Forever data
facts.note: Wowhead Forever database. Plan raid nights around your own flasks, elixirs and food.

facts.label: Camp buffs
facts.value: Profession camp objects give weaker copies of class buffs that do not stack with the real ones; you sit at the camp for at least 1 minute
facts.note: Warcraft Tavern. Whether they last into raids is not stated.

facts.label: Spell hit from talents
facts.value: Precision improves hit with all spells at 2%, 4% or 6%.

facts.label: Spell hit cap against raid bosses (Forever)
facts.note: No official Forever value has been published.

facts.label: Fire crit
facts.value: Five points in Incineration give 10% crit on its affected spells. Critical Mass now caps at three points for 6% crit.

facts.label: Heating Up
facts.value: Fireball, Frostfire Bolt, Fire Blast and Scorch crits cut the next Pyroblast's cast by 25% per stack (3 stacks = 1.5 sec); the buff lasts 20 sec and every Fire Blast adds a stack

facts.label: Stat focus
facts.value: Spell power and spell hit lead; the guides disagree on which comes first
facts.note: Warcraft Tavern (beta) puts spell power first; Icy Veins treats hit as the top stat until capped.

facts.label: Personal Scorch and Ignite
facts.value: Each Fire Mage keeps their own Improved Scorch stacks and Ignite; one Mage can no longer hold Scorch for the raid

facts.label: Fire Power
facts.value: Fire Power raises your Fire damage by 1% for each of your Fire effects on the target at rank 1, up to 4%, and by 3% per effect, up to 12%, at 3/3. Effects that mix schools of magic do not count.

facts.label: Combustion
facts.value: Combustion: each of your Fire spell hits adds 10% crit chance with Fire spells until you have scored 3 non-periodic Fire crits. It has a 3 min cooldown.

facts.label: Threat: Burning Soul
facts.value: Burning Soul: your Fire spells cause 10% less threat at rank 1 and 30% less at 3/3, and have a 23% to 70% chance not to lose casting time when you take damage.

facts.label: AoE: Improved Flamestrike
facts.value: Improved Flamestrike adds 5% crit chance to Flamestrike per rank, up to 15% at 3/3.

facts.label: Classic 1.12 caster kit (reference)
facts.value: Flask of Supreme Power, Greater Arcane Elixir, Brilliant Wizard Oil, Major Mana Potion, Mageblood Potion, Demonic or Dark Rune, Nightfin Soup, Sagefish Delight

facts.label: Classic 1.12 engineering extras (reference)
facts.value: Goblin Sapper Charge, Thorium Grenade and Dark Iron Bomb for engineers

facts.label: Classic 1.12 fire resistance sources (reference)
facts.value: Onyxia Scale Cloak (+16), Drakefire Amulet (+15), Juju Ember (+15 for 10 min), Greater Fire Resistance cloak enchant (+15), fire protection potions

facts.label: Spell hit from talents
facts.value: The renamed Precision improves hit with all spells at 2%, 4% or 6%.

facts.label: Spell hit cap against raid bosses (Forever)
facts.note: Icy Veins' Frost guide (27 Oct) says a cap exists but its value is not known yet.

facts.label: Ice Lance
facts.value: Ice Lance and Fire Blast share an 8-second cooldown. Frozen targets take the restored 300% damage bonus.

facts.label: Fingers of Frost
facts.value: Fingers of Frost gives your Chill effects a 15% chance to make your next spell treat the target as Frozen, or your next 2 spells at 2/2. The effect lasts 15 sec, and the talent requires Ice Lance.

facts.label: Frostfire Bolt for hybrids
facts.value: Counts as Fire and Frost; Blizzard's example is Ignite plus Ice Shards making its crits deal 280%

facts.label: Winter's Chill is personal
facts.value: Its stacks only boost your own next Cone of Cold; Frost no longer gives the raid a crit debuff

facts.label: Threat and mana: Frost Channeling
facts.value: Frost Channeling: your Frost spells cost 5% less mana and cause 10% less threat at rank 1, and 15% less mana and 30% less threat at 3/3.

facts.label: Survival: Ice Block
facts.value: Ice Block protects you from all physical attacks and spells for 10 sec, but you cannot attack, move or cast while it lasts. It has a 5 min cooldown.

facts.label: Ice Barrier
facts.value: Casting Ice Barrier raises Frost damage by 15% for one minute. An additional 5% applies while the barrier remains intact.

facts.label: Raid utility
facts.value: Arcane Brilliance covers party and raid in the files; Remove Lesser Curse also removes Banes
facts.note: talentsforever and Icy Veins Forever. A Gamewave report on the 16 Oct beta patch says Arcane Intellect is still cast per group, so check it in game.

facts.label: Onyxia
facts.value: Every raider carries their own Drakefire Amulet, and Blizzard asks for fire resistance before the fight

facts.label: Classic 1.12 Frost Mage kit (reference)
facts.value: Flask of Supreme Power, Greater Arcane Elixir, Elixir of Frost Power, Brilliant Wizard Oil, Major Mana Potion, Mageblood Potion, Demonic or Dark Rune, Nightfin Soup

facts.label: Conjured supplies
facts.value: Conjure Water makes 20 bottles per cast, Conjure Food rank 6 makes 20 sweet rolls, and mana gems are unchanged in the files

facts.label: World buffs in raids
facts.value: Rallying Cry of the Dragonslayer is marked 'No effect while in a raid instance' in Forever data
